professionalSummary.text: Senior Backend Engineer with 3+ years at L5 (senior engineer) level at Ardent Ledger Software, where they designed and built backend services for billing systems including proration, tax calculation, and invoice reconciliation.
professionalSummary.witness: Ardent Ledger's engineering director confirmed in writing that the candidate was promoted to level L5 (senior engineer) in April 2023 and held that level until leaving in July 2026, three years and four months in all; Ardent uses the title Backend Engineer at every level.
